data.short_description: Ascent Indoor Adventure Park is planning a new location at the former Dick's Sporting Goods space at Lisbon Landing, occupying over 40,000 square feet. The facility will feature a trampoline park, bumper car arena, climbing wall, indoor sports courts, arcade, Ninja course, and 6 private party rooms. The park is currently seeking a special permit and no opening timeline has been announced.

data.location: 140 North Main Street, Bristol, CT (Centre Square Village)
data.short_description: Tavello Pizza is coming to 140 North Main Street in Bristol as part of the Centre Square Village development in Downtown Bristol. The restaurant will feature wood-fired Neapolitan-style pizza, salads, gelato, an espresso bar, beer & wine, and pizza making workshops. Tavello is planned to open this summer.

data.short_description: Mr. P's Frozen Treats announced plans to open a new ice cream shop at Centre Square Village at 140 North Main Street in Bristol. The shop is planned to open this summer alongside Tavello Pizza as part of the new development.

data.location: 501 Boston Post Road, Orange, CT (Liberty Plaza)
data.short_description: Genesis Brunch Co. is coming soon to Liberty Plaza in Orange at 501 Boston Post Road, occupying the former Latin Escape Bar & Restaurant space. The restaurant will offer brunch and breakfast foods and will feature a bar, spacious dining room, outdoor patio, photo booth, and private booth seating. The space is currently being renovated and the restaurant is actively hiring staff.
